title: test-0113-SOC-GEO-TRANSPORT
passage: Many people mistakenly believe that India’s vast river network is fully navigable for large ships, but in reality, only specific stretches are developed for inland water transport. Similarly, it is a common myth that pipelines are exclusively used for supplying drinking water to cities. In truth, pipelines are a vital network for transporting crude oil, petroleum products, and natural gas from refineries to inland locations. Another frequent misunderstanding involves the Golden Quadrilateral superhighway project. Many assume it connects every major state capital, but it specifically links the four major metropolitan cities of Delhi, Mumbai, Chennai, and Kolkata. Finally, some students think that a country’s economic health is determined by balancing exports and imports perfectly. However, international trade is considered a barometer of economic prosperity when the value of exports exceeds the value of imports, creating a favorable balance of trade. By understanding these transport and trade realities, we can better appreciate how the national economy functions. Pipelines reduce trans-shipment losses, while the Golden Quadrilateral significantly reduces travel time between the four major hubs, proving that infrastructure is the lifeline of our nation.
summary: Many people mistakenly believe that India’s vast river network is fully navigable for large ships, but in reality, only specific stretches are developed for inland water transport. In truth, pipelines are a useful way to carry crude oil, petroleum products, and natural gas from refineries to inland places.
